sources.title: Uffici Centrali
sources.publisher: Governatorato dello Stato della Città del Vaticano

conditions.label: Has employees
conditions.description: Pays wages or salaries and runs a payroll.

conditions.label: Registered for VAT
conditions.description: Registered for value added tax or a similar turnover tax.

profileFields.label: Company name
profileFields.description: The registered name, including the S.r.l. legal form. Italian law on civil legal persons applies supplementarily in Vatican City, and the entity is entered in the Vatican register of civil legal persons.

profileFields.label: Numero di registrazione
profileFields.description: The number the company register gave the company.

profileFields.label: Registered office address
profileFields.description: The address on the company register.

profileFields.label: Capitale sociale
profileFields.description: The capital the company was registered with. Leave it empty if the form has no share capital.

roles.label: Director
roles.description: Runs the company and represents it.

roles.label: Shareholder
roles.description: Owns shares or a stake in the company.

setupSteps.title: Choose and check the S.r.l. name
setupSteps.description: Check the name is free in Registro vaticano delle persone giuridiche civili and follows Vatican City's naming rules.
setupSteps.authority: Registro vaticano delle persone giuridiche civili

setupSteps.title: Prepare the S.r.l. documents
setupSteps.description: Prepare the articles or statutes, the founders' details and the registered office. The registration process sets out what it needs.
setupSteps.authority: Registro vaticano delle persone giuridiche civili

setupSteps.title: Register the S.r.l.
setupSteps.description: Submit the incorporation documents as Registro vaticano delle persone giuridiche civili requires. The company exists once the register enters it.
setupSteps.authority: Registro vaticano delle persone giuridiche civili

setupSteps.title: Register the S.r.l. for tax
setupSteps.description: Register with Governatorato dello Stato della Città del Vaticano for the company's tax number and any VAT or payroll accounts it needs.
setupSteps.authority: Governatorato dello Stato della Città del Vaticano

setupSteps.title: Register as an employer
setupSteps.description: Before the first hire, register with Governatorato dello Stato della Città del Vaticano for payroll and social contributions.
setupSteps.authority: Governatorato dello Stato della Città del Vaticano

setupSteps.title: Open a business bank account
setupSteps.description: Banks usually ask for the registration certificate and the tax number.

setupSteps.title: Check licences for your activity
setupSteps.description: Some activities need a permit or a licence from a sector regulator. Check before you start trading.

obligations.title: Annual return or confirmation statement
obligations.description: Check whether an annual return or confirmation statement is due with Registro vaticano delle persone giuridiche civili, then file it and keep the company record current.
obligations.authority: Registro vaticano delle persone giuridiche civili

obligations.title: Annual financial statements
obligations.description: Prepare the annual accounts. Check whether they must be filed with Registro vaticano delle persone giuridiche civili, the deadline and whether an audit is required.
obligations.authority: Registro vaticano delle persone giuridiche civili

obligations.title: Corporate income tax return
obligations.description: Check the company's income tax filing with Governatorato dello Stato della Città del Vaticano, then file the return and pay by the dates it sets.
obligations.authority: Governatorato dello Stato della Città del Vaticano

obligations.title: VAT returns
obligations.description: File VAT returns with Governatorato dello Stato della Città del Vaticano and pay any VAT due. Check whether the company is registered and how often it files.
obligations.authority: Governatorato dello Stato della Città del Vaticano

obligations.title: Payroll taxes and social contributions
obligations.description: Withhold and remit payroll taxes and social contributions for employees through Governatorato dello Stato della Città del Vaticano. Check the rates and dates.
obligations.authority: Governatorato dello Stato della Città del Vaticano

obligations.title: Beneficial ownership information
obligations.description: Check whether the country requires a beneficial ownership filing. If it does, keep the record up to date and file it with Registro vaticano delle persone giuridiche civili.
obligations.authority: Registro vaticano delle persone giuridiche civili

obligations.title: Report changes to the register
obligations.description: Check what changes must be reported to Registro vaticano delle persone giuridiche civili, then tell it about changes to the name, address, directors or share capital within its deadline.
obligations.authority: Registro vaticano delle persone giuridiche civili

obligations.title: Renew licences and permits
obligations.description: Check which licences your activity needs and renew them before they expire.
